artifact.canonical_name: Moebius: Serving Mixture-of-Expert Models with Seamless Runtime Parallelism Switch

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.26607v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors propose Moebius to switch MoE serving between expert and tensor parallel layouts at runtime without restarting the engine.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify evaluation setup and switching overhead
targets.finding: Moebius evaluates runtime switching between tensor parallelism and expert parallelism for MoE serving; its experiments include Qwen3-235B-A22B on an 8xH200 node and report sub-second switching overhead.
